thesis_summary.thesis: CKX Lands, Inc. is a Louisiana land and mineral royalty company listed on NYSE American. **[Fact]** The company owns and manages approximately **7,023 net acres** across Louisiana parishes, earning passive income from oil and gas royalties, timber sales, surface easements, and occasional land sales. **[Fact]** CKX does not explore for or operate oil and gas wells; third-party operators produce on leased acreage while CKX collects royalties ranging from **0.0045%** to **7.62%** across **20** producing fields. **[Fact]** The company has **two** part-time employees, **no** debt, and **no** dividend program. **[Fact]** Following a **November 18, 2025** sale of **6,548** wholly-owned acres for **$8,618,022** cash, roughly **90%** of remaining net acres are co-owned undivided interests requiring unanimous co-owner consent for major decisions. **[Fact]** The Board has evaluated strategic alternatives since **August 2023**, including potential sale of the company or additional asset dispositions.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may treat CKX as a stagnant micro-cap land stub whose earnings spike was a one-time land sale, missing the ongoing strategic-alternatives process and the cash-rich balance sheet relative to run-rate royalties. **[Fact]** FY2025 net income was **$3.0 million** (**$1.47** per share) but included a **$3,557,868** land-sale gain; operating profit excluding that gain was roughly **$83,000**. **[Fact]** Cash and equivalents totaled **$18.0 million** at **December 31, 2025** (**~$8.78** per share) against stockholders equity of **~$10.47** per share at **March 31, 2026**. **[Inference]** At **~$10.59** (June 10, 2026), the stock trades near GAAP book while cash alone covers a large fraction of the quote, with co-owned acreage and royalty streams as a free option. **[Inference]** Predictive attribute: **dormant asset** plus **market structure discount** (thin float, no analyst coverage, no dividend screen inclusion).
